items.excerpt: Free beta synth that builds editable patches from written descriptions, via a research-based database mode or an optional local AI model through Ollama that lets you keep refining the patch with text instructions.
items.title: Box Of Rules releases Box Of Synths, a FREE prompt-driven synthesizer beta

items.excerpt: MOOER's VE200 is a compact stereo vocal multi-effects pedal for live performers with real-time processing and an AI StemLab stem-separation feature built in.
items.title: MOOER VE200: A Portable Vocal Processor with AI StemLab

items.excerpt: AI vocal platform Voice-Swap has joined DDEX and plans to contribute consent and authorization metadata standards as AI vocals become part of real production and commercial workflows.
items.title: Voice-Swap Joins DDEX, Eyes Permissions Metadata Expansions

items.excerpt: Qobuz is rolling out tags that flag AI-generated tracks in its catalog, saying musical discovery must remain guided by human choices.
items.title: Qobuz Rolls Out a Tag to Flag AI-Generated Music

items.excerpt: The NHL's San Jose Sharks dropped a Suno-generated goal song after intense fan backlash branded it a 'slop song'.
items.title: San Jose Sharks Nix Suno-Generated Goal Song After Backlash

items.excerpt: Spotify becomes the first streaming service to plug into Meta's new Muse AI agent as a connector, letting people request and control music through the assistant.
items.title: Spotify is first music service to connect to Meta Muse AI agent

items.excerpt: Sony Music Group joins the ARIAM responsible-AI policy coalition alongside Disney, the BBC and The New York Times, backing AI that enhances rather than undermines human creativity.
items.title: Sony Music group joins ‘responsible AI’ policy coalition Ariam

items.excerpt: LANDR expands its machine-learning fraud detection, built with research lab Mila, and says Spotify-flagged artificial streams on music it distributes fell 95% between Q1 2025 and Q2 2026.
items.title: LANDR expands AI fraud detection built with machine learning lab Mila – and says artificial streams flagged by Spotify for music it distributes fell 95% between Q1 2025 and Q2 2026 - Music Business Worldwide

items.excerpt: Suno confirms its V6 models were trained partly on user 'creations' while calling the new Sony/Universal complaint fundamentally flawed.
items.title: Suno confirms V6 model was trained on ‘creations’ from users, as it blasts latest Sony and Universal lawsuit - Music Business Worldwide

items.excerpt: Acon Digital's Acoustica 8 audio editor rebuilds DeNoise and DeHum on machine learning and adds Extract:Dialogue 2 and other AI-powered restoration and mastering tools.
items.title: Acon Digital’s Acoustica 8 audio editor is the company’s “most ambitious release to date”

items.excerpt: Michael Smith, who pled guilty to generating thousands of AI songs and botting them to billions of streams, asks for no prison time in the first-ever streaming fraud criminal case.
items.title: AI Music Fraudster Wants No Prison for $8M Scam: ‘No Victim Suffered Any Real Harm’

items.excerpt: A blind choir singer explains the realities of reading music without sight and where AI note recognition, score conversion and AI vocal tools could help.
items.title: What It Actually Takes to Read Music Without Sight (and What AI Can Help Solve)

items.excerpt: Suno Studio now lets you arm a track and record audio directly onto the timeline of its AI-assisted DAW.
items.title: You can record straight to the timeline in Suno Studio.

items.excerpt: Suno introduces Studio Chat, a conversational assistant inside Suno Studio for directing the AI while you build a song.
items.title: Meet Studio Chat
